summary: Output written outside egress boundaries isn't masked, so pass it through mask_secrets before writing, as in the log file example.
questions: Is output my plugin writes to a file masked automatically?

answer_card.title: Mask output you write yourself
answer_card.answer_md:
No. Wrap it:
```python
with open('/var/log/my_plugin.log', 'a') as fd:
    fd.write(mask_secrets(f"request completed: {response_text}\n"))
```
